ps2.2:1.5: “ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti tathametaṃ avitathametaṃ anaññathametaṃ ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti tathametaṃ avitathametaṃ anaññathametaṃ, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti tathametaṃ avitathametaṃ anaññathametaṃ,
ps2.2:1.6: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri tathāni avitathāni anaññathāni.”
ps2.2:2.2: cattāro dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā:
ps2.2:2.4: ime cattāro dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā,
ps2.2:3.2: cattāro samudayassa samudayaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā:
ps2.2:3.4: ime cattāro samudayassa samudayaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā,
ps2.2:4.2: cattāro nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā:
ps2.2:4.4: ime cattāro nirossa nirodhaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā,
ps2.2:5.2: cattāro maggassa maggaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā:
ps2.2:5.4: ime cattāro maggassa maggaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā,
ps2.2:7.3: dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho tathaṭṭho,
ps2.2:7.4: imehi catūhākārehi tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni,
ps2.2:8.3: dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho anattaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho anattaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho anattaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho anattaṭṭho,
ps2.2:8.4: imehi catūhākārehi anattaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni,
ps2.2:9.3: dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho saccaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho saccaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho saccaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho saccaṭṭho,
ps2.2:9.4: imehi catūhākārehi saccaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni,
ps2.2:10.3: dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho,
ps2.2:10.4: imehi catūhākārehi paṭivedhaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni, yaṃ ekasaṅgahitaṃ taṃ ekattaṃ,
ps2.2:11.2: yaṃ aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ, yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ aniccaṃ yaṃ aniccañca dukkhañca taṃ anattā.
ps2.2:11.3: yaṃ aniccañca dukkhañca anattā ca taṃ tathaṃ,
ps2.2:11.4: yaṃ aniccañca dukkhañca anattā ca tathañca, taṃ saccaṃ,
ps2.2:11.5: yaṃ aniccañca dukkhañca anattā ca tathañca saccañca, taṃ ekasaṅgahitaṃ
ps2.2:12.3: tathaṭṭhena anattaṭṭhena saccaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena abhiññaṭṭhena pariññaṭṭhena pahānaṭṭhena bhāvanaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena.
ps2.2:13.3: dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho tathāṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, abhiññāya abhiññaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, pariññāya pariññaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, pahānassa pahānaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, bhāvanāya bhāvanaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, sacchikiriyāya sacchikiriyaṭṭho tathaṭṭho.
ps2.2:13.4: imehi navahākārehi tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:14.5: dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, abhiññāya abhiññaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, pariññāya pariññaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, sacchikiriyāya sacchikiriyaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho.
ps2.2:14.6: imehi navahākārehi paṭivedhaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:15.3: tathaṭṭhena anattaṭṭhena saccaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena abhijānanaṭṭhena parijānaṭṭhena dhammaṭṭhena dhātuṭṭhena ñātaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena phusanaṭṭhena abhisamayaṭṭhena.
ps2.2:15.4: imehi dvādasahi ākārehi cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni,
ps2.2:16.1: kathaṃ tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekapaṭivedhāni: soḷasahi
ps2.2:16.3: dukkhassa pīḷanaṭṭho saṅkhataṭṭho santāpaṭṭho viparināmaṭṭho tathaṭṭho,
ps2.2:16.4: samudayassa āyūhanaṭṭho nidānaṭṭho saṃyogaṭṭho paḷibodhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho,
ps2.2:16.5: nirodhassa nissaraṇaṭṭho vivekaṭṭho asaṅkhataṭṭho amataṭṭho tathaṭṭho,
ps2.2:16.6: maggassa niyyānaṭṭho hetuṭṭho dassanaṭṭho ādhipateyyaṭṭho tathaṭṭho,
ps2.2:16.7: imehi soḷasahi ākārehi tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekaṅgahitāni,
ps2.2:17.12: soḷasahi ākārehi abhisamayaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekapaṭivedhāni:
ps2.2:17.13: dukkhassa pīḷanaṭṭho saṅkhataṭṭho santāpaṭṭho viparināmaṭṭho abhisamayaṭṭho
ps2.2:17.14: samudayassa āyūhanaṭṭho nidānaṭṭho saṃyogaṭṭho paḷibodhaṭṭho abhisamayaṭṭho,
ps2.2:17.15: nirodhassa nissaraṇaṭṭho vivekaṭṭho asaṅkhataṭṭho amataṭṭho abhisamayaṭṭho,
ps2.2:17.16: maggassa niyyānaṭṭho hetuṭṭho dassanaṭṭho ādhipateyyaṭṭho abhisamayaṭṭho.
ps2.2:17.17: imehi soḷasahi ākārehi abhisamayaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:19.3: saṅkhatānaṃ saccānaṃ uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyati. asaṅkhatassa saccassa na uppādo paññāyati, na vayo paññāyati, nana ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati.
ps2.2:20.3: dukkhasaccassa uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyati.
ps2.2:20.4: samudayasaccassa uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati.
ps2.2:20.5: maggasaccassa uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāti, ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati.
ps2.2:20.6: nirodhasaccassa na uppādo paññāyati, na vayo paññāyati, na ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati.
ps2.2:21.1: catunnaṃ saccānaṃ kati kusalā, kati akusalā, kati abyākatā:
ps2.2:21.2: samudayasaccaṃ akusalaṃ, maggasaccaṃ kusalaṃ, nirodhasaccaṃ abyākataṃ,
ps2.2:21.3: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā kusalaṃ, siyā akusalaṃ, siyā abyākataṃ.
ps2.2:22.1: siyā tīṇi saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni, ekasaccaṃ tīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṃ
ps2.2:22.5: evaṃ akusalaṭṭhena dve saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni, ekasaccaṃ dvīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṃ.
ps2.2:22.7: evaṃ kusalaṭṭhena dve saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni. ekasaccaṃ dvīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṃ.
ps2.2:22.9: evaṃ abyākataṭṭhena dve saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni, ekasaccaṃ dvīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṃ
ps2.2:22.10: evaṃ siyā tīṇi saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni, ekasaccaṃ tīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṃ vatthuvasena pariyāyenāti. [sāvatthinidānaṃ]
ps2.2:23.1: “pubbeva me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi:
ps2.2:23.2: ko nu kho rūpassa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ,
ps2.2:23.3: ko vedanāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
ps2.2:23.4: ko saññāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
ps2.2:23.5: ko saṅkhārānaṃ assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
ps2.2:23.6: ko viññāṇassa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇanti.
ps2.2:23.8: ‘yaṃ kho rūpaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ,
ps2.2:23.17: yaṃ viññāṇaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ
ps2.2:24.1: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya ‘anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho’ti. paccaññāsiṃ. yato ca khvāhaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ pañcannaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya ‘anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho’ti paccaññāsiṃ.
ps2.2:25.1: yaṃ rūpaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ rūpassa assādoti
ps2.2:25.3: yaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo’ti
ps2.2:25.5: yo rūpasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ idaṃ rūpassa nissaraṇanti
ps2.2:25.7: yā imesu tīsu ṭhānesu diṭṭhi saṅkappo vācā kammanto ājīvo vāyāmo sati samādhi
ps2.2:26.4: yaṃ viññāṇaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ viññāṇassa assādo’ti
ps2.2:26.6: yaṃ viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ ayaṃ viññāṇassa ādīnavo’ti
ps2.2:26.8: yo viññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ idaṃ viññāṇassa nissaraṇanti
ps2.2:26.10: yā imesu tīsu ṭhānesu diṭṭhi saṅkappo vācā kammanto ājīvo vāyāmo sati samādhi
ps2.2:27.8: jarāmaraṇañca pajānāti, jarāmaraṇasamudayañca pajānāti, jarāmaraṇanirodhañca pajānāti, jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañca pajānāti,
ps2.2:28.5: jātiñca pajānāti, jātisamudayañca pajānāti, jātinirodhañca pajānāti, jātinirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañca pajānāti,
ps2.2:29.5: bhavañca pajānāti, bhavasamudayañca pajānāti, bhavanirodhañca pajānāti, bhavanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañca pajānāti,
ps2.2:30.5: upādānañca pajānāti, upādānasamudayañca pajānāti, upādānanirodhañca pajānāti, upādānanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañca pajānāti,
ps2.2:31.3: taṇhā vedanānidānā vedānāsamudayā, vedanā jātikā, vedanāpabhāvāti
ps2.2:31.5: taṇhañca pajānāti, taṇhā samuyañca pajānāti, taṇhānirodhañca pajānāti, taṇhānirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañca pajānāti,
ps2.2:32.5: vedanañca pajānāti, vedanāsamuyañca pajānāti, vedanānirodhañca pajānāti, vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadañca pajānāti,
ps2.2:33.5: phassañca pajānāti, phassasamudayañca pajānāti, phassanirodhañca pajānāti, phassanirodhagāminī paṭipadañca pajānāti,
ps2.2:34.5: saḷāyatanañca pajānāti, saḷāyatanasamudayañca pajānāti, saḷāyatananirodhañca pajānāti, saḷāyatananirodhagāminīpaṭipadañca pajānāti,
ps2.2:35.5: nāmarūpañca pajānāti, nāmarūpasamudayañca pajānāti, nāmarūpanirodhañca pajānāti, nāmarūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadañca pajānāti,
ps2.2:36.5: viññāṇañca pajānāti, viññāṇasamudayañca pajānāti, viññāṇanirodhañca pajānāti, viññāṇanirodhagāminī paṭipadañca pajānāti,
ps2.2:37.5: saṅkhāre ca pajānāti, saṅkhārasamudayañca pajānāti, saṅkhāranirodhañca pajānāti, saṅkhāranirodhagāminī paṭipadañca pajānāti,
ps2.2:38.1: jarāmaraṇaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, jātisamudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ,
ps2.2:38.2: jāti dukkhasaccaṃ, bhavo samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ.
ps2.2:38.3: bhavo dukkhasaccaṃ, upādānaṃ samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ.
ps2.2:38.4: upādānaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, taṇhā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ
ps2.2:38.5: taṇhā dukkhasaccaṃ vedanā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ.
ps2.2:38.6: vedanā dukkhasaccaṃ, phasso samudayasaccaṃ ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ.
ps2.2:38.7: phasso dukkhasaccaṃ, saḷāyatanaṃ samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ.
ps2.2:38.8: saḷāyatanaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, nāmarūpaṃ samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ.
ps2.2:38.9: nāmarūpaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, viññāṇaṃ samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ.
ps2.2:38.10: viññāṇaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, saṅkhārā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ.
ps2.2:38.11: saṅkhārā dukkhasaccaṃ, avijjā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ.
ps2.2:39.1: jarāmaraṇaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, jāti siyā dukkhasaccaṃ, siyā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ,
ps2.2:39.2: jāti dukkhasaccaṃ, bhavo siyā dukkhasaccaṃ siyā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ …pe…
ps2.2:39.3: saṅkhārā dukkhasaccaṃ, avijjā siyā dukkhasaccaṃ, siyā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccanti.
